name: Make
description_en:
Make is a visual automation service for connecting applications and transforming data between them. Its workflows are called scenarios. Each scenario contains modules for reading, processing, or writing information, with mapping and flow controls determining how the information moves. It is relevant when a repeated business process involves several systems and the operator wants to inspect the intermediate data.

For example, a new spreadsheet entry can become a team notification. More involved scenarios may split a list into individual records, route records by conditions, and combine outputs again. Understanding these data movements is essential: a small diagram can still perform many operations.

This profile explains Make through its modules, bundles, credits, scheduling, and recovery settings. The purpose is to help you judge a specific workflow, including its cost and failure behavior. No scenario was executed for this review, and no claim of reliability or time savings has been measured.
description_zh:
Make 是用于连接应用并转换数据的可视化自动化服务。它把工作流称为 scenario，由读取、处理或写入信息的模块组成，通过字段映射和流程控制决定数据如何传递。当重复业务涉及多个系统，而且维护者希望检查中间数据时，可以把它列入候选。

例如，表格新增记录可以转成团队通知。更复杂的流程可以把列表拆成单条记录、按条件分流，再合并输出。理解这些数据变化很重要：流程图看起来很小，也可能执行大量操作。

本文围绕模块、bundle 数据包、credits、调度与恢复设置展开，帮助判断一条具体流程的成本与失败行为。本文没有实际运行 scenario，也未测量可靠性或节时效果。

core_features.explanation_en: Arrange connected app modules to transfer and transform business data.
core_features.explanation_zh: 连接应用模块，传递并转换业务数据。

core_features.explanation_en: Use conditions to send data into routes; router routes are processed sequentially.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按条件把数据交给不同路线；路由器的路线按顺序处理。

core_features.explanation_en: Split arrays into bundles and explicitly gather results into the required output shape.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把数组拆成数据包，再按所需结构明确汇总结果。

core_features.explanation_en: Optionally retain unfinished runs for investigation and eligible recovery.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按设置保留未完成的执行，以便调查及在适用条件下恢复。

en: Turn a new spreadsheet request into a team notification.
Split a list into individual processing units and aggregate the required results.

把列表拆成单独处理单元，再汇总需要的结果。

faq.question_zh: 使用 Make 必须接入 AI 吗？
faq.answer_en: No. Its introductory scenario sends app data between Google Sheets and Slack without an AI step.
faq.answer_zh: 不必。入门流程直接在 Google Sheets 和 Slack 之间传递数据，无需 AI 步骤。

faq.question_en: Can all intermediate fields be used after aggregation?
faq.question_zh: 聚合后还能直接使用所有中间字段吗？
faq.answer_en: No. Include the required values in the aggregator output; intermediate bundles are not automatically forwarded.
faq.answer_zh: 不能。需要把所需值纳入聚合输出，中间数据包不会自动全部传给后面。

sections.title_en: Start with one business record and a clear destination
sections.title_zh: 从一条业务记录和明确目标开始
sections.en:
Choose a handoff such as a new request becoming a notification, then identify the source fields and what the destination should receive. Mapping connects data supplied by one module to inputs used by another. Inspect a representative source bundle before building the destination message or record.

Our suggested acceptance check compares the actual destination fields with the intended result, including a blank optional field and a non-ASCII value. A successful scenario status is not enough to show that the right information reached the right person. This is a test recommendation, not a test performed for the profile.
sections.zh:
可以从“新请求转成通知”这类交接开始，先明确来源字段和目标应接收的内容。映射把一个模块提供的数据连接到另一个模块的输入。填写目标消息或记录前，先检查一条具有代表性的来源数据包。

建议验收时核对目标字段是否符合预期，并检查可选字段为空、含非 ASCII 字符等情况。仅有成功状态，不能证明正确的信息已经送达正确对象。这是测试建议，本文未实际执行。

sections.title_en: Why one scenario run can mean many module operations
sections.title_zh: 为什么一次场景运行会产生多次模块操作
sections.en:
A bundle is one unit of related data, such as a contact or file. An operation is a module run that checks or processes data. A trigger can retrieve several bundles in one check; downstream modules can then run separately for each bundle. That distinction explains why the number of runs, modules, and processed records are not interchangeable.

When reading the execution inspector, inspect both the operation count and the bundles it handled. A diagram with two downstream writes can generate far more than two operations if many records flow through it.
sections.zh:
bundle 是一组相关数据，例如一个联系人或文件；operation 是模块进行一次检查或处理。触发器一次检查可以获取多个数据包，后面的模块再为每个数据包分别运行。因此，场景运行次数、模块数量和处理记录数量不能互相替代。

查看执行详情时，应同时检查操作次数和每次处理的数据包。即使图上只有两个后续写入模块，输入记录较多时，也可能远不止两次操作。

sections.en:
Iterator converts an array into separate bundles. For an illustrative attachment workflow, that lets the next step handle each file individually. It also changes how often later modules run. Use it only when the downstream operation really should act on each array element; do not add another iterator merely because the source already returns several bundles.

Aggregation gathers bundles into an output structure. Make’s aggregator documentation notes that values inside the aggregation scope are not automatically available afterwards: include the fields needed downstream in the aggregator configuration. Check both output count and field completeness.
sections.zh:
Iterator 把数组转成多个独立数据包。例如，在附件处理流程中，后一步可以逐个处理文件；同时，后续模块的运行次数也会改变。只有确实需要逐项操作数组元素时才应使用。来源已经返回多个数据包时，不应仅因此再加一个迭代器。

聚合则把数据包汇总成输出结构。Make 的聚合文档说明，聚合范围内部的值不会自动全部保留给后续步骤，需要在配置中纳入后续所需字段。应同时检查输出条数与字段完整性。

sections.title_en: Routing is not the same as parallel execution
sections.title_zh: 分支路由不等于并行执行
sections.en:
A router creates routes with conditions and can include a fallback for data that matches none of the other routes. Make documents that these routes are processed sequentially. This is a different question from whether separate scenario executions run concurrently.

Define which outcomes are intended to be exclusive and test the filter conditions accordingly. Do not assume a branch diagram itself proves that only one destination will receive a record. This recommendation concerns workflow correctness; no throughput advantage was measured.
sections.zh:
路由器可建立带条件的路线，并为不符合其他路线的数据设置后备路线。Make 文档说明，这些路线按顺序处理。它与多次场景执行是否并发，是两个不同问题。

需要先明确哪些业务结果应该互斥，再据此测试筛选条件。不能仅凭一张分支图，就推定一条记录只会送达一个目标。这是流程正确性建议，本文没有测量吞吐优势。

sections.title_en: Use the current AI Agent documentation
sections.title_zh: 采用现行 AI Agent 文档
sections.en:
Make distinguishes fixed-logic scenarios, scenarios that call an AI app, and scenarios where an agent chooses actions using tools and context. The current Make AI Agent (New) documentation describes open beta availability; functionality and pricing can change. Make’s provider is available across plans, while custom provider connections require a paid plan.

Agent usage has its own mix of operation and token charges, with tool and knowledge activity also relevant. A simple one-credit-per-operation estimate for a conventional scenario must not be carried over unchanged. Use the current agent-specific metering page, not the older Agent app reference.
sections.zh:
Make 区分固定逻辑场景、调用 AI 应用的场景，以及由 Agent 结合工具和上下文选择动作的场景。现行 Make AI Agent (New) 文档将其标为公开测试，功能与定价可能变化；各套餐均可使用 Make 提供的模型连接，自定义服务商连接则需要付费套餐。

Agent 费用会结合操作和 token，工具及知识处理也会影响消耗。普通场景按每次操作一个 credit 的简单估算，不能原样套用。应使用现行 Agent 专项计费说明，而不是旧版 Agent 应用参考。

sections.title_zh: credits、操作次数与 AI 费用
sections.en:
Make uses credits for billing and operations for module activity. Most non-AI activity follows a fixed rate of one credit per operation, while some features use different or dynamic rates. AI costs depend in part on the app and connection type: a custom provider connection can involve provider token charges in addition to Make usage.

For a simple hypothetical design, one polling check returns ten records and two ordinary downstream modules each process all ten. That is 1 + 10 + 10 = 21 operations. At a one-credit fixed rate it would be 21 credits. This illustration excludes retries, extra lookups, AI rates, and other modules; it is not a measured bill.
sections.zh:
Make 用 credits 计费，用 operations 表示模块活动。多数非 AI 活动按每次操作一个 credit 的固定费率计算，部分功能则有不同或动态费率。AI 成本还取决于应用及连接方式；使用自定义服务商连接时，除了 Make 用量，还可能向模型服务商支付 token 费用。

假设一次轮询检查得到十条记录，后面两个普通模块分别处理全部十条，那么操作次数为 1 + 10 + 10 = 21。在每次一个 credit 的固定费率下，对应 21 credits。此例未包含重试、额外查询、AI 费率或其他模块，不是实测账单。

sections.title_zh: 免费版限制与付费报价的待确认项
sections.en:
The official pricing result read on 22 October 2026 lists an ongoing Free plan with 1,000 monthly credits and a 15-minute minimum scheduling interval. A free account is therefore usable within an allowance, not unlimited automation. Paid plans vary with usage tier and billing period.

The directly rendered pricing page omitted its plan matrix, while the indexed official result included it. We retain the dated free-plan facts but leave a normalized paid price unset. Before purchase, verify the selected currency, cadence, credit allowance, extra-credit settings, and storage/data-transfer limits in the current plan view.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的官方定价结果列出持续免费套餐：每月 1,000 credits，最短调度间隔 15 分钟。免费账户是在额度内使用，并非无限自动化。付费价格会随用量档位和账单周期变化。

直接读取的定价页面没有完整呈现套餐表，而官方页面的索引结果包含该表。本文保留带日期的免费版事实，付费标准金额仍留空。购买前应在当前套餐界面核对币种、周期、credit 额度、额外购买设置，以及存储和数据传输限制。

sections.title_en: Match the trigger to the required response time
sections.title_zh: 按所需响应时间选择触发方式
sections.en:
Scheduled scenarios check according to their configured interval; the minimum depends on the plan. Some modules support immediate triggering, but the schedule control cannot make every source provide event notifications. Consider whether the process tolerates a delayed check before paying for a shorter schedule.

For webhook workflows, Make can receive events over HTTPS. Separate executions run in parallel by default; ordered processing waits for the previous run. If two events update the same business record, explicitly evaluate order, duplicate handling, and the acceptable queue delay. These settings do not establish a delivery-time guarantee.
sections.zh:
定时场景按配置间隔检查，最小间隔受套餐限制。部分模块支持即时触发，但调度设置不能让所有来源都主动发送事件。应先判断业务能否容忍延迟检查，再决定是否为更短间隔付费。

webhook 流程可以通过 HTTPS 接收事件，独立执行默认并行；顺序处理则等待前一次完成。同一业务记录可能被两个事件修改时，应明确验证顺序、重复处理及可接受的排队延迟。这些设置不能直接证明某个交付时限。

sections.title_en: An unfinished run needs an explicit recovery policy
sections.title_zh: 未完成的运行需要明确恢复方式
sections.en:
Incomplete-execution storage is disabled by default according to its dedicated guide. Enabling it can retain unfinished work for manual resolution or automatic retry for supported cases. Storage capacity limits still apply.

Error handlers have different semantics. Skip can remove a failing bundle and leave a successful status; Resume can substitute an output. Therefore, a green run is not proof that every input record was processed. For important records, compare source identifiers with destination results and decide who reviews exceptions. That comparison is an editorial recommendation, not a built-in completeness guarantee.
sections.zh:
专项指南说明，未完成执行的存储默认关闭。启用后可保留未完成工作，由人处理，或在支持的情形下自动重试，但仍受存储容量限制。

错误处理器的语义不同：Skip 可以移除失败数据包并让执行显示成功，Resume 可以用替代输出继续。因此，绿色状态不能证明每条输入都已处理。重要业务建议用来源标识核对目标结果，并明确异常由谁检查。这是编辑建议，不是产品自动提供的完整性保证。

sections.en:
The error-handling documentation limits rollback to modules that support transactions; modules without transaction support make changes immediately. A recovery design must therefore account for earlier side effects in other applications. Do not assume that a later error unsends a message or removes an external record already created.

Before rerunning, decide which completed operations can safely repeat and which need a lookup or another duplicate-control method. This is particularly relevant to financial records or customer communications, where an additional successful write may still be the wrong business outcome.
sections.zh:
错误处理文档把回滚限定在支持事务的模块范围内；不支持事务的模块会立即产生修改。因此，恢复方案要考虑其他应用中已经发生的副作用。后续出错，不代表之前发送的消息会撤回，或已经创建的外部记录会删除。

重跑前应区分哪些操作可以安全重复，哪些需要先查询或采取其他防重复方式。财务记录和客户沟通尤其需要关注：再次写入技术上成功，也可能产生错误的业务结果。

sections.title_en: When a predefined connector is insufficient
sections.en:
Make’s HTTP app supports configurable API requests, including authentication and pagination options. The current documented HTTP version requires HTTPS and rejects unverified self-signed certificates. A private service that cannot meet those connection requirements needs a separate integration design.

Confirm the service API’s permitted operations, credentials, pagination behavior, and limits. An HTTP module extends the connection options; it does not supply a missing API or grant access to a service account you do not control. No endpoint was called in this research.
sections.zh:
Make 的 HTTP 应用支持配置 API 请求，包括认证和分页选项。当前文档介绍的 HTTP 版本要求 HTTPS，并拒绝未验证的自签名证书。无法满足这些连接条件的私有服务，需要另行设计接入方式。

应确认目标 API 允许的操作、凭据、分页行为和限制。HTTP 模块扩展的是连接方式，不会替目标系统补出 API，也不会授予账户访问权。本文未实际调用任何接口。

sections.title_en: Consider diagnosability alongside privacy and convenience
sections.title_zh: 同时考虑隐私、排错能力与维护便利
sections.en:
The Keep data confidential setting suppresses retained execution payloads and limits troubleshooting options. Decide what operational evidence is necessary and appropriate for the data involved; this setting alone is not a compliance certification. Regional availability, contractual data location, and UI-language coverage were not verified here.

Make is worth shortlisting when the process benefits from explicit mapping, routing, and inspection, and a named operator can maintain it. For a single fixed handoff, a native app integration may suffice. Compare the exact workflow and its data volume; this review does not rank Make as universally easier, cheaper, or more reliable.
sections.zh:
Keep data confidential 设置会避免在执行日志中保留实际载荷，同时也限制排错方式。应结合数据性质决定需要保留什么运营证据；单靠该设置不能证明合规。本文尚未确认地区可用性、合同数据位置和界面语言覆盖。

当流程受益于明确映射、路由和逐步检查，而且有人负责维护时，可以把 Make 列入候选。单一固定交接也可能由原生应用集成满足。应按具体流程和数据量比较，本文不把 Make 排为普遍更易用、更便宜或更可靠的产品。

seo.title_en: Make: Visual Scenarios, Credits, Free Plan and Recovery
seo.title_zh: Make：可视化场景、credits、免费版与失败恢复
seo.description_en: Understand Make modules, bundles, routing, credit costs and incomplete executions before choosing an automation workflow. Includes official sources.
seo.description_zh: 通过官方来源理解 Make 的模块、数据包、路由、credit 成本和未完成执行，帮助判断具体自动化流程是否适用。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate a specific Make workflow, its data movement, cost and recovery behavior.
secondary_questions: How are credits different from operations?
Can a successful run have skipped records?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent hypotheses from primary documentation; no keyword volume, ranking or AI citation rate measured.
